name: King Herod
overview: King Herod is depicted in Scripture as a ruler who, upon hearing of the birth of Jesus, sought to destroy the Messiah by ordering the massacre of children in Bethlehem, revealing his ruthless opposition to God's plan of salvation. The wise men’s visit and Herod’s violent response highlight his fear and hostility toward Christ’s arrival. Additionally, Jesus warns His followers to beware of the 'leaven of Herod,' symbolizing the corrupting influence of worldly and political power. Herod’s perplexity over Jesus’ ministry further underscores his inability to recognize the true identity and authority of the Son of God.
